organizer: Türkiye İş Kurumu (İŞKUR), Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı bünyesinde, Cumhurbaşkanlığı himayelerinde yürütülmektedir
organizer_domain_provenance: stajportali.iskur.gov.tr and its parent portal staj.iskur.gov.tr are both .gov.tr — automatically HIGH-authority official per lib/acquisition/source-authority.ts's looksOfficial() (domain contains '.gov.'). İŞKUR is Turkey's public employment agency, operating under the Ministry of Labour and Social Security, whose own domain (csgb.gov.tr) is linked directly from the site's own header/banner. Explored directly via a live browser session (not just search snippets) across the home, Süreç, Hizmetlerimiz pages and the dedicated stajportali.iskur.gov.tr sub-site's three info tabs.
subjects_fields: general — cross-sector, matched to each participating employer's open positions
grade_range: Lise (high school) students of any type meeting the specific criteria published in each individual open internship listing
prerequisites: İŞKUR'a iş arayan olarak kayıtlı olmak (must be registered with İŞKUR as a job seeker, done via the portal's own 'Sistem Girişi')
Meeting the specific criteria stated in each open internship listing ('Açık staj pozisyonunda öngörülen başvuru kriterlerine uyan tüm lise öğrencileri staj ilanlarına başvurabilir')
duration: Per-listing: each internship posting stays live for a minimum of 1 and maximum of 90 days from publication, extendable by İŞKUR in segments up to a total of 120 days ('90 günlük süre İŞKUR tarafından parçalı olarak en fazla 120 güne kadar uzatılabilir'); the internship's own length 'staj süresi başvurulan staj pozisyonlarına göre farklılık gösterir' (varies by position)
financial_aid: Employer pays the intern monthly under a signed staj sözleşmesi (internship contract). The GENERAL staj.iskur.gov.tr 'Süreç' page (shared framing for both the university and lise tracks) states a minimum monthly payment of approximately 8.422 TL, with İŞKUR subsidising between 2.807 TL and 5.615 TL of that for private-sector internships — but that same page explicitly says the process 'iki uygulamada farklı işlemektedir' (works differently between the two applications) and to check each track's own page for specifics, so I cannot confirm this exact figure applies identically to the lise-specific track; recorded here as an informative but not lise-confirmed figure.
selection_process: Student registers as an İŞKUR job seeker, browses open staj listings matched to their profile on stajportali.iskur.gov.tr, and applies to relevant ones; employers review applicants and invite selected candidates to interview. No obligation to accept a resulting offer ('Böyle bir zorunluluğunuz yoktur'), and an application can be withdrawn if the student can no longer participate.
award_or_output: A completed workplace internship under a signed contract, with iş kazası ve meslek hastalığı (workplace-accident and occupational-illness) insurance coverage under Law No. 5510 Article 5/b, arranged through the student's registered eğitim kurumu (school)
latest_verified_cycle: Ongoing/rolling platform, not a fixed annual cycle — confirmed live as of retrieval on 2026-08-21 (site footer: '© 2026 Türkiye İş Kurumu')

research_notes: This record is DIFFERENT IN CHARACTER from the İŞKUR Staj Portalı record above: it is a MANDATORY CURRICULAR COMPONENT specifically required of (not merely open to) vocational-high-school students, coordinated through the student's own school rather than something a student individually discovers and applies to. Included deliberately because the task asked to verify internships genuinely open to lise students rather than assume any 'staj' listing applies to them, and this is a large-scale, real, government-regulated system that plainly does apply to lise-level (specifically meslek lisesi, ~17-18-year-old) students — a legitimate and honestly-different answer to the same underlying question. FLAGGED STALENESS: the only concrete wage figure on the official page (631 TL, cited as a 2020 example) is six years old as of this research; I have not computed or substituted a 2026 equivalent since 2026's minimum wage was not confirmed on this page and using outside knowledge to compute it would violate this task's evidence standard. LEFT UNKNOWN: exact 2026 minimum-wage-linked payment amount; whether internships can begin in 11th grade in addition to 12th (secondary sourcing suggested this but the official page's own text specifies 12th grade); any citizenship restriction (structurally this applies to students enrolled in the Turkish national vocational curriculum, which was not phrased as an explicit nationality rule on the page).
